title: Translate Video exports match your source video
summary: Translate Video exports follow the uploaded video's real frame rate and quality, phone and rotated videos no longer export stretched or juddering, and child organizations inherit Keep original video quality.

items.title: Exports follow the video you uploaded.
items.body: Frame rate, audio and bitrate come from the upload.

children.body: Phone videos with a variable frame rate export at their real, measured rate.
Videos at a standard rate of 60 fps or lower keep it, so screen recordings keep every frame of motion.

items.title: Keep original video quality now carries through to the export.
items.body: With the setting on, exports are encoded at the source video's bitrate instead of a fixed preset, so they look as close to the original as possible.

items.title: Child organizations follow their parent's setting.
items.body: Keep original video quality now applies to child organizations that never set it themselves. A child organization's own choice, on or off, still wins.

items.title: Some uploads exported stretched or juddering.
items.body: Rotated videos, files that aren't MP4 or MOV, and videos whose timing doesn't start at zero are now re-encoded on upload, so they export at the right shape and pace.
